[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:387YE Spring]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Mitwold, Seconded: Upwold">To commission a sinecure - Stone Smith's Workshop - in the Woldstone, Ashbrook, Upwold. Sinecure is to be a place where smiths can congregate, discuss, act as a repository of lore, and be a place to train new smiths. Sinecure to create the Stone Smith position, to be appointed by tally of the votes. This sinecure is self funded.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Ashbrook, Upwold
* Passed
* More information on the smiths can be found on the [[smith]] page and the '''[[A_pinch_of_salt|A pinch of salt]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Spring 387YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 8 white granite
* 8 mithril
* 8 ilium
* 6 thrones
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Stone_Smith%27s_Workshop}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Stone Smith]] will be available for election by Tally of the Votes of Marcher [[farm]] owners for the first time at the Autumn Equinox 387YE
